requirements: Required workflow source pinned to exact repository_id/path/ref/SHA outside candidate control
Require pull request before canonical update
No bypass actor for normal candidate/controller path
Required workflow event must be supported by ruleset workflow; workflow_dispatch alone is insufficient
Verifier job uses contents:read only and checkout persist-credentials:false
Candidate bytes and trusted verifier bytes checked out separately
Untrusted candidate code is not executed on host until W47 isolation gate proves the sandbox boundary
Ruleset/provider configuration itself remains Human/provider-admin controlled

constraints: Do not put provider-write credentials on Win11 worker
Do not accept a same-name GitHub Actions check as trusted merely because its app_id is GitHub Actions when candidate can define another workflow
Do not weaken to Skill-only policy
No paid fallback without Human Mission change

bootstrap_sequence: Human explicitly authorizes HG47-TRUST exact scope
Provider-admin channel verifies plan/capability and captures prestate
Publish approved trusted verifier workflow/script as immutable bootstrap source
Create or update exact ruleset/protection with no normal bypass
Pin required workflow/check trust source to exact immutable source
Read back provider protection/ruleset and verifier source
Negative test: raw update_ref by normal Chat/candidate actor must be rejected
Positive test: compliant PR plus trusted verifier can update canonical through provider-native merge path
Negative test: candidate-modified verifier/expected-set cannot satisfy the trusted gate
Recovery test: scoped recovery path is separate and cannot silently become normal writer
Only then record CSG-03B PASS and allow CSG-04A/CSG-05 acceptance

steps: If rule activation blocks legitimate path, leave canonical ref at last verified SHA
Disable or revert the new rule through provider-admin channel using captured prestate; do not force-move canonical ref
Read back exact canonical ref and protection/ruleset state
